source: 8. How should you choose between fixed-size, structure-aware, and semantic chunking? [Advanced - Judgment] Fixed-size chunking is cheap, deterministic, and a useful baseline. Structure-aware chunking follows boundaries such as sections, paragraphs, code blocks, or table units and is often preferable when the source format contains meaningful hierarchy. Semantic chunking tries to place boundaries where topics change, but adds model or embedding dependence and is not guaranteed to outperform simpler methods on every corpus. Findings ACL 2025 work on document segmentation shows that overly large and overly small segments create different failure modes and that segmentation can improve both retrieval and end-to-end QA, while a 2026 evaluation on academic texts also found a tested cluster-based semantic chunking method did not outperform simpler fixed-size or recursive strategies. Choose by source structure and measured evidence retrieval. Preserve stable document IDs and parent hierarchy so the system can retrieve a narrow child for precision while still expanding to its section or document when broader context is needed. [4][31]
zh: 8. 在固定大小、结构感知和语义分块之间应该如何选择？ [高级 - 判断] 固定大小的分块成本低、具有确定性并且是有用的基线。结构感知分块遵循节、段落、代码块或表单元等边界，并且当源格式包含有意义的层次结构时通常更可取。语义分块尝试在主题变化的地方设置边界，但增加了模型或嵌入依赖性，并且不能保证在每个语料库上都优于更简单的方法。 ACL 2025 关于文档分割的研究结果表明，过大和过小的片段会产生不同的故障模式，并且分割可以改善检索和端到端 QA，而 2026 年对学术文本的评估还发现，经过测试的基于集群的语义分块方法并没有优于更简单的固定大小或递归策略。按来源结构和测量证据检索进行选择。保留稳定的文档 ID 和父层次结构，以便系统可以检索狭窄的子文档以实现精确性，同时在需要更广泛的上下文时仍扩展到其部分或文档。 [4][31]
